name: GTX Manufacturing, LLC
old_description: We are a full service contract manufacturing company with over 40 years of combined experience in wire harness / cable assembly / electromechanical assembly.
about:
GTX Manufacturing, LLC operates from Clay City, Kentucky, where it provides contract manufacturing services specializing in wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and electromechanical assemblies. The company describes itself as a full-service contract manufacturer with over 40 years of combined experience among its personnel.

The shop’s core capabilities include wire harness assembly (with harnesses exceeding 300 circuits), cable assembly, semi-automatic crimping, ultrasonic wire splicing (Sonobond), inkjet and hot-stamp wire marking (using a KIP 20 machine), connector overmolding and rubber injection molding for environmental protection, potting and encapsulating, J-STD-001 soldering, IPC-620A workmanship, 100% electrical testing on Cirris equipment, reverse engineering, and general box-build assembly. Prototyping and low-run production are offered alongside volume work.

GTX serves customers in automotive, heavy-equipment, trailer, and trucking markets, producing engine and chassis harnesses, trailer harnesses, dump-truck harnesses, and heavy-equipment harnesses. The company works with major connector brands such as Deutsch, Molex, Tyco, Yazaki, Sumitomo, and JST.

GTX emphasizes lean manufacturing and ISO 9001 principles to deliver cost-competitive solutions, and highlights its ability to provide full production solutions from prototyping through final assembly.
